approved_definition_context:
ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability on the finite-dimensional real inner-product space E. MeasureTheory.Lp at exponent 2 is the actual square-integrable equivalence-class Hilbert space, and MemLp.toLp forms the class of its literal argument. Polynomial.hermite j is the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial, evaluated in the reals by the canonical coefficient map. The infinity order in ContDiff is smooth real Frechet differentiability on the entire ambient domain.

    Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] →
      [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] →
        [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] →
          [BorelSpace E] → ℕ → E → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E)) :=
fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] j w =>
  let p := Polynomial.map (Algebra.algebraMap ℤ ℝ) (Polynomial.hermite j);
  MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp (fun x => Polynomial.eval (Inner.inner ℝ w x) p) ⋯
def anonymous_object_2.{u_1} : {E :
    Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →

fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] s c
    w =>
  ∑ j ∈ s, c j • anonymous_object_1 j w
